reason: I already buy bread at the village bakery every morning and the dekkene owner is my neighbour and lets me pay at the end of the month. I'd be giving up credit and a walk-down shop for a bag fee and a half-saving I can't be sure of.
objection: The dekkene lets me pay at month end and I know the owner. Here it's cash or Whish, and $1.25 a bag plus half the saving only; I'd need to see that I really come out ahead of the Tawfeer offers I already follow myself.
would_change_my_mind: Pay at the end of the month from the first bag, and a first slip or two showing I clearly save more than the bag fee on a normal list.
